proposal.json, written by servtuner propose: the next configurations of a tuning session to boot or run, each with its ladder and a rationale, or a done verdict. A pure function of the search space, the boot results and the analysed bundles: the same inputs give the same bytes. The caller sets the labels of each proposal on the RunSpec it makes (servtuner.dev/tuning-ladder and servtuner.dev/tuning-config); servtuner propose classifies bundles by the ladder label.

Schema file: `schema/json/proposal.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `d9b231432260`.

| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`      | `"propose"`, `"done"`                                                          | Yes      | propose: there is more to run. done: the search ended; see done.                                                      |

## Definitions

### proposalPhase

Type: `"feasibility"`, `"baseline"`, `"screen"`, `"confirm"`, `"done"`

### proposalTierStatus

| Field    | Type                                                      | Required | Description             |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------- |
| `tier`   | [tuningTier](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningtier) | Yes      |                         |
| `state`  | `"pending"`, `"active"`, `"converged"`                    | Yes      |                         |
| `reason` | `string`                                                  | No       | Why the tier converged. |

### proposalLeader

The configuration to beat; absent before any run.

| Field             | Type                                                            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `config_id`       | `string`                                                        | Yes      | A short stable name of a knob set: "c-" and the first 8 hex digits of the sha256 of the knobs as JSON with sorted keys and no spaces (json.Marshal of the map). The tuning session stores it. pattern `^c-[0-9a-f]{8}$` |
| `knobs`           | [tuningKnobSet](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobset) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `slo_max_rps`     | `number`                                                        | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `objective_value` | `number`                                                        | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `run_ids`         | array of `string`                                               | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### proposalProposed

| Field       | Type                                                                | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `config_id` | `string`                                                            | Yes      | A short stable name of a knob set: "c-" and the first 8 hex digits of the sha256 of the knobs as JSON with sorted keys and no spaces (json.Marshal of the map). The tuning session stores it. pattern `^c-[0-9a-f]{8}$` |
| `action`    | `"boot_probe"`, `"run"`                                             | Yes      | boot\_probe: deploy with no load and report a boot result. run: benchmark with the ladder.                                                                                                                              |
| `knobs`     | [tuningKnobSet](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobset)     | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `ladder`    | [proposalLadder](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalladder)       | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `repeats`   | `integer`                                                           | No       | How many runs of the configuration to make; absent for a boot probe. ≥ 1                                                                                                                                                |
| `labels`    | map of `string`                                                     | Yes      | The RunSpec labels the caller must set: servtuner.dev/tuning-config is the config\_id and servtuner.dev/tuning-ladder the ladder kind (absent for a boot probe).                                                        |
| `rationale` | [proposalRationale](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalrationale) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### proposalLadder

The offered load of the run: requests per second of each stage, ascending.

| Field        | Type                                                                  | Required | Description                                                        |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `kind`       | [proposalLadderKind](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalladderkind) | Yes      |                                                                    |
| `rps`        | array of `number`                                                     | Yes      | at least 1 item                                                    |
| `centre_rps` | `number`                                                              | No       | The SLO-max the ladder is centred on; absent for the probe ladder. |

### proposalLadderKind

Type: `"probe"`, `"screen"`, `"full"`

### proposalRationale

| Field           | Type                                                                                                                      | Required | Description                                                                 |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`          | `"boot_probe"`, `"baseline"`, `"structural_ab"`, `"advisor"`, `"grid"`, `"scheduler_ab"`, `"fine_tuning_ab"`, `"confirm"` | Yes      | Why it was proposed.                                                        |
| `tier`          | [tuningTier](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningtier)                                                                 | No       | Absent for the baseline and the confirmation.                               |
| `advisor`       | `string`                                                                                                                  | No       | The vLLM advisor rule that fired (V1 to V7).                                |
| `grid_cell`     | [proposalGridCell](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalgridcell)                                                         | No       |                                                                             |
| `against`       | `string`                                                                                                                  | No       | The leader's config\_id, for a step that is an A/B against it.              |
| `based_on_runs` | array of `string`                                                                                                         | Yes      | Run ids the proposal reads: the leader's, or the confirmed configuration's. |
| `text`          | `string`                                                                                                                  | Yes      |                                                                             |

### proposalGridCell

Where a coordinate step moved from the leader (rationale kind grid): one of max\_num\_seqs and max\_num\_batched\_tokens up or down, the other at the centre. Before 2026-11-24 a cell of a 3x3 grid around the leader.

| Field                    | Type                                                              | Required | Description |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `max_num_seqs`           | [proposalPosition](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalposition) | Yes      |             |
| `max_num_batched_tokens` | [proposalPosition](/reference/schemas/proposal/#proposalposition) | Yes      |             |

### proposalPosition

Type: `"down"`, `"centre"`, `"up"`
